# T029 acceptance evidence

Active November6 from clean02ff265. Baseline1145 historical tracked SHA entries
recorded before adding sources; state/backlog excluded. Declared old edits only
registries/README/same Nov6 report pair. Existing input_sync/UART/GPIO/CPU/board/
XPR/XDC/firmware/architecture unchanged; defaultsingle100MHz coreclock unchanged.
No tools/packages/IP download/install, global configuration, push, scheduler or
FPGA programming. Unrestricted/never runtime, attendedonly. FormalT023 remains
owner-skipped/NOT RUN. All other milestones/reviews required.

New reset_sync.sv reusable external wrapper: asynchronous assert, FPGAINIT11,
two-edge synchronous release, ASYNC_REG+SHREG_EXTRACT=NO, clk_i/arst_i/rst_o.
Core reset stays synchronous; no new target clock. Existing input_sync widths
1..32, default16; independent levels, no atomic bus/pulse/debounce promise.
T031 must instantiate the tested boundary and raw GPIO/UART inputs once. Current
XPR remains board diagnostic with its original inline reset.

Three reference tests PASS. Actual native preparation cdc-20261106T223420874717Z
PASS50checks/25commands: two seeds1645 rows each(3290total),49 heldreset/36 subcycle
pulses perseed, phases0..3, widths1/16/32 and all32onehot; actual clockstopped/
INIT hooks, wrongreset/empty/truncated andinvalidWIDTH33 controls, three digital
RTL mutations detected. Pulse0.2ns is idealRTL only, not physicalminpulse proof.

Actual primary-input virtualclock probe FAIL: complete timingconstraints but
zeroCDCobjects/AllpathsSafelyTimed, plus GUI-only-name warnings. Archive5inputs/
6generatedfiles exact; never count emptyreport asproof. Read installed2025.2 help
and authorized officialAMD docs;14input investigationZIP preserves4receipts,
including read-only option probes and registeredsource analysis. Fullhelpreturned
must be printed explicitly; firstcommandinventory probe returned no helpstdout.

Analysis-only registered offchip source fixture makes18paths visible. Actual
tool reports CDC3Info RX1/depth2, CDC9Info reset1/depth2, CDC6Warning GPIO16/depth2.
RetainWarning/notwaived: GPIObits independentlevels, no coherentmultibitpromise.
No severity/message override. Guards enforce exactly3groups/18chains/36ASYNCstages,
exclusivefirststagefanout/commonclock/no waivedorunknownpaths and complete timing
constraints. Actual missingRXattribute producesCDC2Warning/rejected; stagebypass
producesCDC4Critical/rejected. SourceFF/external13nsclock only inDV, target stays
one10nsclock; analysisnotrouted/physicaltiming. See docs/CDC_REPORT.md.

Next python -B scripts/harness.py finish T029 --evidence evidence/daily/T029.md,
attempt1/3; lint/test-cdc/whitespace. Afterpassaudit source/receipt/vectors/waves/
